[EN] Mission Orders

Eliminate cursed beings in the depths of the Hungry Caverns.

Your targets are {@LinkCreature:8#4011#aberrant gulons}, {@LinkCreature:8#4021#reanimated popori}, {@LinkCreature:8#4032#caiman bonethralls}, {@LinkCreature:8#4031#skeletal caimans}, {@LinkCreature:8#4041#cruel inquisitors}, {@LinkCreature:8#4051#vulgar inquisitors}, {@LinkCreature:8#4052#vicious auric imps}, and {@LinkCreature:8#4061#undying miners}.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Elimina a los seres malditos en las profundidades de los Hungry Caverns.

Tus objetivos son los {@LinkCreature:8#4011#aberrant gulons}, los {@LinkCreature:8#4021#reanimated popori}, los {@LinkCreature:8#4032#caiman bonethralls}, los {@LinkCreature:8#4031#skeletal caimans}, los {@LinkCreature:8#4041#cruel inquisitors}, los {@LinkCreature:8#4051#vulgar inquisitors}, los {@LinkCreature:8#4052#vicious auric imps} y los {@LinkCreature:8#4061#undying miners}.
